description: List a website's URLs without fetching its pages: its sitemaps (from robots.txt, else /sitemap.xml) plus the start page's links, same site only, up to `limit` (<= 5,000). Use it to find the right pages before contextfetch_extract_url or contextfetch_crawl. Costs 1 credit.

exclude_paths.description: Regexes; never list URLs whose path matches one.

include_paths.description: Regexes; only list URLs whose path matches one, e.g. ["^/blog/"].

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the site (any page on it).

name: contextfetch_map
title: ContextFetch site map
